added.title: Application Engineer, US Projects
added.description:
Who We Are And What You’ll Do

HOLOPLOT is redefining what's possible in professional audio. Our Matrix Array technology enables precise, software-defined control of sound in three dimensions - a fundamentally new approach grounded in physics and realized through purpose-built hardware and software.

Our systems power some of the most ambitious audio installations in the world, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - currently the largest audio installation in entertainment.

The thoughtful integration of electroacoustic, DSP, control, and audio networking platforms will achieve a cohesive solution that meets the demanding technical and operational requirements of the venues we work with.

We're looking for a hands-on Application Engineer to support planning, commissioning, and optimization of HOLOPLOT systems across key US venues and projects.

The ideal candidate is

You are a high-energy, hands-on Application Engineer with experience in professional audio, acoustics, or sound system engineering. You have worked on loudspeaker systems in complex environments such as entertainment venues, theatres, arenas, or immersive audio spaces.

You are practical, technically curious, and confident in fast-moving on-site situations. Your experience may include system tuning, audio networking, signal flow, rigging coordination, venue operations, client-facing project work, demos, or technical training. You are excited by beamforming, spatial audio, and next-generation sound system design.

Main objectives of the role

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge audio technology and real-world project delivery — supporting system design, on-site commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer relationships for high-profile installations.

After a structured onboarding, you'll take ownership of defined work packages and represent HOLOPLOT independently at venues such as Radio City Music Hall, Sphere, and similar projects.

Core Responsibilities

Support system design and simulation using HOLOPLOT PLAN, proprietary tools, EASE, and similar software
Translate venue and client requirements into practical technical solutions
Prepare technical deliverables: simulation results, system proposals, measurement reports, stakeholder documentation
Commission, tune, test, and troubleshoot HOLOPLOT systems on-site
Communicate professionally with venue teams, integrators, production crews, and internal colleagues
Provide remote and on-site after-sales support including venue changes and new shows
Assist with product demos, training sessions, and partner education
Document project learnings and contribute to workflow improvements and best practices

What you need to succeed in this role

3–6 years of experience in professional audio, acoustics, system engineering, AV integration, or event technology
Hands-on experience planning, installing, testing, or commissioning loudspeaker systems in complex venues
Degree or equivalent practical background in acoustics, audio engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field
Working knowledge of acoustic simulation tools (EASE, CATT, or similar)
Experience with measurement tools (SMAART, EASERA, or comparable)
Familiarity with 3D drafting or CAD tools (SketchUp, Revit, AutoCAD) is a plus
Strong problem-solving skills,comfort working in live venue and construction environments, and confidence in demanding customer-facing situations
Ability to work independently on defined tasks after onboarding
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
High energy, reliability, and a willingness to learn complex technology
Frequent (~25% on average, 50% in key project phases) travel within the US; occasional international travel
Fluency in English

We offer you

At HOLOPLOT, you’ll work on technology that is redefining professional audio, with direct impact on globally visible projects. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across applications, software, hardware, product, research, and project delivery, in an environment that offers a high degree of ownership, hands-on learning, and real growth opportunities.

For our US-based employees, we offer competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support wellbeing, financial security, and a productive work setup.

About Us

HOLOPLOT is a pro audio company from Berlin, Germany. Since early 2011, we have been working on radically transforming audio technology, by re-thinking the underlying physics of sound reproduction. We wondered: What if sound could truly be controlled the way we can control light? What if we could create soundscapes that feel more real than reality? What if every seat in a venue could be made the best seat?

Our solution is science-based, software-driven, and hardware-enabled: the HOLOPLOT Matrix Array. The sound system for a new era, a powerful tool that brings previously inaccessible capabilities to the world of audio. We believe when people experience better sound, they will enjoy more meaningful moments and create richer memories. At HOLOPLOT, it is our mission to redefine what is possible - enabling unparalleled and breathtaking experiences.

A revolution in sound. Be part of it.

added.title: Full Stack Engineer - CDW Migration
added.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

Trilogy Federal seeks an experienced Full Stack Engineer to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Summit Advanced Tooling, Lakehouse, and Artificial Intelligence Services (Summit ATLAS) program. The Full Stack Engineer will design, develop, and maintain applications, interfaces, and supporting services that enable the modernization and migration of VA's Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW) capabilities to the Summit Data Platform.

This position will support the optional CDW Migration workstream by modernizing legacy application functionality, integrating cloud-based data services, and developing secure, scalable solutions that maintain continuity for existing users while enabling adoption of modern data and analytics capabilities.

Please note, this position is contingent upon award (anticipated early 2027). This role will also require 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Primary Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications, web interfaces, and supporting services that enable access to migrated CDW data and analytical capabilities.

Modernize legacy application functionality and workflows to operate within the Summit cloud environment while maintaining essential business capabilities.

Develop and maintain front-end components using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular.

Design and implement back-end services, application programming interfaces (APIs), and integration components using Python, C#, Java, or comparable technologies.

Integrate applications with Azure Databricks, Azure SQL services, and other approved Summit data platform components.

Support migration and coexistence strategies that allow legacy CDW applications and modernized solutions to operate during transition periods.

Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and migration teams to implement secure access to migrated datasets, semantic views, and approved data services.

Implement Government-approved authentication, authorization, and data access controls, including integration with enterprise identity management services.

Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests to validate application functionality, data access, and compatibility with migrated services.

Troubleshoot application defects, integration failures, and performance issues, implementing corrective actions to maintain reliable operations.

Optimize application performance, scalability, and resource utilization within cloud-based environments.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, including application architecture, interface specifications, deployment procedures, and operational support guidance.

Collaborate with VA stakeholders and technical teams to validate migrated functionality, support user acceptance testing, and resolve issues affecting production readiness.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.

Seven or more years of professional experience in full stack software development, enterprise application modernization, or related software engineering disciplines.

Experience developing and maintaining enterprise web applications using modern front-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or comparable technologies.

Strong proficiency in at least one back-end programming language such as Python, C#, or Java.

Experience designing, developing, and integrating RESTful APIs and service-based application architectures.

Proficiency in Structured Query Language (SQL) and experience integrating applications with relational databases and enterprise data services.

Experience developing and deploying applications within Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud environments.

Knowledge of application authentication, authorization, secure coding practices, and role-based access controls.

Experience implementing automated testing, source control, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices.

Experience troubleshooting complex application integrations, performance issues, and production defects.

Experience working within Agile development teams and collaborating with architects, data engineers, and business stakeholders.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.

Ability to meet VA personnel vetting, background investigation, and system access requirements.

The ability to travel for 1-2 domestic business trips per year.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting VA or other federal agency application modernization or data migration initiatives.

Experience modernizing applications that depend on large enterprise data warehouses or legacy analytical platforms.

Hands-on experience integrating applications with Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, or Azure Synapse Analytics.

Familiarity with Databricks Unity Catalog, governed data access, and migration of legacy security views.

Experience developing cloud-native applications using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, or containerized deployment technologies.

Experience supporting phased migration, parallel operations, and application coexistence during enterprise modernization.

Experience working with sensitive healthcare data and federal privacy and security requirements.

Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate or comparable cloud application development certification.

Benefits (including But Not Limited To)

Health, dental, and vision plans

Optional FSA

Paid parental leave

Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1

Paid time off and 11 paid holidays

No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage

Pet insurance

Monthly phone and internet stipend

Tuition and training reimbursement

This range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as Trilogy Federal conducts an individual equity review for every candidate based on experience, location, education, industry experience, and comparisons to internal pay bands. In addition to salary, Trilogy offers robust benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance coverage, 401(k) match, paid holidays, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and a very supportive work/life balance. To cut down on falsified applications and to avoid subjecting real candidates to screening by AI assistants, phone interviews at Trilogy require either a landline or a cellphone number backed by a physical SIM. We cannot conduct interviews with candidates who provide VOIP contact numbers (including Google Voice).
